verdict.rationale: Gmail's Gemini feature documents a 'Schedule' capability that proposes meeting times from the user's Google Calendar availability, which covers sharing availability in an email. The evidence is one line, with no detail on how times are inserted into the message or whether recipients can book a slot directly. missing for 10: evidence that times are inserted directly into the email body, recipient-bookable slots, detailed first-party docs on the workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
